local_Base_Y_line.method: local line through calibrated image-midline intersections at near/far accepted X; camera distortion included

feasible_window.near_boundary: camera can fully observe the cube features required for reliable localization
feasible_window.far_boundary: existing arm policy can complete the grasp sequence
feasible_window.lateral_boundaries: near-distance camera visibility constrains the final parking region; no far-distance lateral mapping required
feasible_window.numeric_bounds_status: provisional linear acceptance adopted by user; no far-side samples required

parking_target.preference: within the usable window, keep the cube as near as practical and its center as close to image width/2 as practical
parking_target.when_centerline_not_visible: choose the feasible position closest to the camera image midline
parking_target.boundary_clearance_basis: user-selected cube-center inset for object volume; no extra stopping-error margin added
parking_target.image_control_reference: cube center projection horizontal target equals image width/2 (640 at 1280 pixels)
parking_target.when_centerline_outside_allowed_region: choose the allowed center position closest to the camera image midline

window_scope.purpose: near, centered final parking region for arm handoff
window_scope.user_decision: Far-left and far-right boundary captures are unnecessary; distant or strongly lateral positions are not desired final parking positions.
window_scope.existing_far_reference_role: longitudinal normalization endpoint 1 and approach distance reference; not desired final parking location
window_scope.remaining_work: integrate the position classifier with chassis approach and stopping; refine the formula later if needed

normalized_window.input: raw cube center in mechanical-arm Base mm, before grasp compensation

lateral.sample_reference_role: retain the measured left/right separation as the width scale; their original midpoint no longer defines the centerline

normalized_window.acceptance: cube center must lie inside both inclusive intervals after a 10mm inward offset of each rectangle edge
normalized_window.centerline_target: projected cube center u = image width/2; normalized lateral zero follows this line
normalized_window.provenance_note: Raw photos remain local; numeric references above are self-contained and require no data/ files at runtime.
normalized_window.inset_basis: User 2026-10-24: convert the approved normalized rectangle to Base mm, then shrink all four edges inward by 10mm for the 20mm cube volume.
normalized_window.recenter_policy: preserve longitudinal limits, lateral width and 10mm inset; shift lateral bounds at each X to center on the camera image midline
